info.name: EzzyHub — Full GP Test Suite
info.description:
Complete test collection for the EzzyHub Graduation Project.

Services covered:
• Requirement Analyzer  → http://localhost:8081
• Code Analyzer         → http://localhost:8080
• Python NLP Service    → http://localhost:8000

Run order: Health Checks → Requirement Analyzer → Python NLP → Code Analyzer → Matching

formdata.description: Select your project ZIP file here in Postman

request.description:
Main Code Analyzer endpoint.
Uploads a ZIP file → runs 2-pass LLM analysis.

Pass 1: Full project semantic overview (architecture, stack, patterns).
Pass 2: Deep per-file, per-class, per-method breakdown.

Expected response: AnalysisResult JSON with structure + semanticAnalysis + fileAnalyses.

⚠️ Takes 30–120 seconds for large projects.
⚠️ Requires LLM API key configured in backend/.env

item.name: 4.1 Match — All Stored Requirements vs ZIP

formdata.description: Upload the project ZIP to match against requirements

request.description:
The MAIN integration endpoint — runs the full matching pipeline:
1. Loads ALL requirements from MySQL
2. Sends ZIP to Code Analyzer (port 8080)
3. NLP-processes each code feature via Python (port 8000)
4. Computes weighted Jaccard (35%) + cosine similarity (65%) per requirement
5. Classifies each: IMPLEMENTED (≥0.80) / PARTIAL (0.40-0.79) / MISSING (<0.40)
6. Returns MatchReport with coverage %

⚠️ All 3 services must be running before calling this.
⚠️ Requires requirements to be pre-loaded via Section 1 endpoints.

_postman_response_example.body: { "projectName": "my-project", "timestamp": "2026-05-17T08:00:00Z", "processingTimeMs": 18500, "totalRequirements": 10, "implementedCount": 6, "partialCount": 3, "missingCount": 1, "coveragePercentage": 60.0, "totalSourceFiles": 45, "analyzedFileCount": 25, "codeFeatureCount": 120, "llmProvider": "gemini", "status": "success", "results": [ { "requirementId": "FR-1.1.1", "requirementText": "The system shall allow a new user to create an account...", "score": 0.87, "status": "IMPLEMENTED", "jaccardScore": 0.72, "cosineScore": 0.95, "matchedFilePath": "src/main/java/UserController.java", "matchedMethodName": "register", "matchedSemanticText": "Handles new user registration" }, { "requirementId": "FR-7.1.2", "requirementText": "The system shall calculate similarity score...", "score": 0.55, "status": "PARTIAL", "jaccardScore": 0.40, "cosineScore": 0.63 }, { "requirementId": "FR-8.1.1", "requirementText": "System sends requirement to AI API...", "score": 0.21, "status": "MISSING" } ] }
